HFK Olomouc ''' is a [[Football in the Czech Republic|football club in the Czech Republic]], based in [[Olomouc]]. The club is currently{{when|date=August 2025}} playing in the [[Czech regional championships]]. The club previously played in the [[Czech 2. Liga]] from [[2005–06 Czech 2. Liga|2005–06]] until relegation in the [[2008–09 Czech 2. Liga|2008–09 season]]. In 2012–13, HFK Olomouc finished third in the Second Division but were relegated due to financial difficulties.{{cite news|last=Dočkal|first=Jan|url=http://fotbal.idnes.cz/fotbaliste-hfk-olomouc-budou-hrat-jen-msfl-fjz-/fot_dsouteze.aspx?c=A130611_090007_fot_dsouteze_rou|title=První liga na předměstí? Ne, HFK Olomouc padá a řeší "sázkaře"|language=cs|website=[[iDNES.cz]]|date=11 June 2013|accessdate=20 June 2013|publisher=[[Mafra (company)|Mafra]]}} Following a promotion to the 2. Liga for the 2000–01 season, the club changed its name from FK Holice 1932 to 1. HFK Olomouc. 1. HFK Olomouc advanced to the last 16 stage of the [[Czech Cup]] during the [[2002–03 Czech Cup|2002–03]], [[2004–05 Czech Cup|2004–05]], [[2005–06 Czech Cup|2005–06]] and [[2010–11 Czech Cup|2010–11]] seasons, but never made it into the quarter finals, losing on each occasion."}}
